groundVoidDerivation.input: Only explicit observedGroundCorrections basementAreaways with positive depth
groundVoidDerivation.output: Export manifest groundVoids records retain buildingId, frontage line, normalized position, width, outward depth and an explicitly authored below-surface cut envelope.
groundVoidDerivation.limits: Width is stored both as frontage fraction and derived worldWidth; cutExtent is outward from the facade and steps descend toward the facade. Below-surface depth is a collision/visual cut envelope pending measurement. No void is inferred for an unlisted frontage. Runtime sidewalk and solid-plane cuts remain a downstream world implementation task.

unmodifiedCoverage: The remaining frontageInventory records have no discrete geometry correction encoded by this revision. Existing schedules and original namespaces remain authoritative until a matching view supplies an observed change.
limits: This ledger records observed feature types and bounded source coverage. It does not claim complete present-day occupancy, measured dimensions, successfully modeled geometry, or 1:1 facade acceptance. Durable view metadata and scoped frontage records are keyed in model-source/west-seventh-reference-04.json; public provenance is retained where supplied. Candidate mappings remain pending matched visual review.
